statement_en: 0.406 <= pectoral/SL <= 0.823 for a measured specimen; a design outside the range is above or below it.

hypotheses.statement: 0.406 <= pectoral/SL <= 0.823 for a measured specimen; a design outside the range is above or below it.

scope.basis: Daane 2021 Data S1: preserved flying-fish specimens
scope.note: A statement about the RECORD. A design outside the range is outside everything measured, which is weaker than impossible, and no theorem here says such a fish cannot exist. Preserved museum specimens, lengths only: no mass, no fin area, no glide data. It is deliberately NOT a constraint in the ledger, so that nothing is ever reported as eliminated by it; it is a flag in the Design Studio.

observations: Across 49 flying-fish specimens, pectoral fin length over standard length runs from 0.406 to 0.823, median 0.687 (standard lengths 1.68 to 24 cm).
evidence.rejectable: Reject it and the Studio loses a provenance flag; no verdict anywhere changes.

non_vacuity_witness.statement: Nonempty Record: the measured numbers satisfy every empirical entry at once

approval.basis: in force in lean/constraints.json / lean/laws.json before the registry existed; no per-law human review recorded by the registry

lean.source:
/-- A ratio outside the measured range is above or below it: a statement about the record, not about what is
possible. No theorem here says such a fish cannot exist. -/
theorem finRatio_outside {r : ℝ} (h : ¬ measuredFinRatio r) : r < 0.406 ∨ 0.823 < r := by
  unfold measuredFinRatio at h
  rcases lt_or_ge r 0.406 with hlt | hge
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  · exact Or.inr (by by_contra hc; exact h ⟨hge, not_lt.mp hc⟩)

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.Empirical.measuredFinRatio
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- Pectoral fin length over standard length, inside the range of the 49 measured flying-fish specimens. -/
def measuredFinRatio (r : ℝ) : Prop := 0.406 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ 0.823
